entries.title: Selecting text highlights it straight away
entries.body: Select a passage in one of your own articles with the mouse and it is highlighted in yellow at once, with its comment box open. Click away to keep it, or choose Remove highlight; copying the passage instead removes the fresh highlight. On a touch screen, press Highlight or comment after selecting. One thing to know: reloading the page straight after highlighting, before it has saved, can lose that highlight. Referee mode keeps its own draft box.

entries.title: Summary shows Brief first, and Fuller is longer
entries.body: The first time a summary is written for an article, the Brief can appear while the Fuller one is still being written. Fuller is longer, at about 500 words. When a summary is rewritten, the saved one stays on screen meanwhile. The hidden middle level is no longer written, so a failure there can no longer lose the whole summary.

entries.title: Reading modes are queued when an article arrives
entries.body: When an article you add is ready, the app itself queues its main modes, such as Summary, Glossary, Quotes and Ideas. The choice to switch this off is saved to your account, not to one browser. The modes are still written only while you have the app open. A last-second High-powered AI choice may miss the first of them.

entries.title: Glossary's Find more adds to older lists
entries.body: Find more adds terms to most glossaries written by earlier versions of the app, where it used to replace them. When a run has to replace the list, the button says Write a new list and explains why. If a further pass finds nothing, it says no more terms worth adding turned up.

entries.title: Search crosses, shortcuts and clearer explanations
entries.body: Both search boxes, in your library and in the bar under an article, show a cross that empties them. Escape leaves the Metadata page, and the command bar shortcut (Cmd-K) works from most text fields. Remember's four buttons each explain themselves when you point at them, and results written for your profile are marked by a profile icon alone.

entries.title: Very long articles and heavy PDFs import
entries.body: Adding a very long article could fail with an error; it now goes through. For PDFs, the size limit on each section is higher, and a section that was too big only because of the extra page sent along for context is read without that page, with a note saying so.

entries.title: Citation checks treat article text more cautiously
entries.body: When the AI checks a citation, reference details taken from the article and from web pages are marked as material to examine, never as instructions to follow. As a result, quick-check assessments and Dig deeper answers saved before this release no longer show; links already found remain. Press Dig deeper again for a current answer.

entries.title: Fixes for narrow windows and copy buttons
entries.body: On a narrow window, opening the Glossary from a term or sending a question to Chat could leave the panel hidden; it now comes into view. On a phone, a card in Structure's list no longer opens off the edge of the screen. Copy buttons no longer show an out-of-date result when pressed twice quickly.
